newsitem.title: USA: First United raises qrtly div 17.6 pct.
newsitem.headline: First United raises qrtly div 17.6 pct.

text.p: First United Bancshares Inc said Wednesday it has raised its quarterly dividend 17.6 percent to $0.20 per share from $0.17 per share.
The dividend is payable June 30 to shareholders of record on June 13, the company said.

First United said this is the sixth year in a row it has raised its quarterly dividend rate. The move was made based on the company's earnings performance, which rose to $0.59 per share in the first quarter from $0.58 per share a year ago.
First United, the holding company for eight affiliate banks in Arkansas and Texas, has $1.56 billion in assets, it said.
